bio: I got into software engineering through my studies in Systems Engineering, where I became particularly drawn to how software systems are designed and how components interact seamlessly. Through my industry experience, I have focused primarily on backend development using Java, Spring Boot, SQL, and REST APIs.

What I enjoy most about backend and systems engineering is solving complex problems behind the scenes. I thrive on architecting systems that are reliable, scalable, and maintainable under real-world workloads, combining programming with deep system-level thinking.
